svg.style: background-color: #f8fafc; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
svg.text: Decoupled Multi-Lane Ingestion · Circular Reservation Station · LsuSuperSlot Cell Array · Coalescing Memory Busses
Each cell tracks 1 byte: state (DONE, W_DATA, W_START, W_RESP, W_WB), data (8b), rowAddr, mask (16B 1-hot)

g.text: W_DATA ──(index/data payload arrive)──► W_START ──(bus tx fires)──► W_RESP
W_RESP ──(bus resp or row snoop)──► W_WB ──(scalar/vector writeback)──► DONE
• Masked-off elements (mask=0) bypass directly from W_DATA to W_WB

svg.text: Decodes rowAddr: ITCM (IMEM), DTCM (DMEM), or External (Peripheral/AXI)
Writes to ITCM trigger immediate ibusFault trap
Zero wait-state pipelined responses · Byte write mask (wmask)
Decoupled streams back to RVV / VME
FENCE.I drains stores & redirects PC fetch to pcNext (pc + 4)
• Latches epc, fault address, write status
